KANDA II

PRAPATHAKA I

The Special Animal Sacrifices

ii. 1. 1.

a For food thee, for strength thee![1]

b Ye are winds, ye are approachers.

c Let the god Savitr impel you to the most excellent offering.

ii. 1. 2.

a He who is rich in kine, in sheep and in horses.

b To Agni he offers who sacrifices.

ii. 1. 3.

a This is thy fitting place of birth.

[1] Cf. Sayana, who takes this as an address to the vessels.
